title: Create budget justification linking 500-node deployment costs to fellowship ask
description: Build detailed budget breakdown: 1) Hardware: 500x LoRa nodes at ~$30 each = $15k, gateway hardware $5k. 2) Conference costs: DEFCON/CCC booth fees, travel, shipping. 3) Fellowship time: dedicated months for spec finalization, community building. Map each line item to specific open deliverables. Show cost-effectiveness vs traditional infrastructure. Include in-kind contributions (existing prototypes, volunteer time). Target total ask and format per Shuttleworth guidelines.
